claims.text: Nonlactational: mixed and gram-neg organisms more common → amox-clav, or metronidazole + dicloxacillin or cephalexin
claims.quote: Nonlactational breast abscesses more frequently involve mixed and gram-negative organisms, making amoxicillin-clavulanate or metronidazole combined with dicloxacillin or cephalexin appropriate options.
